senses.gloss:
न्युप्त न्य्-उप्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि-वप्, q. v.),
offered, presented (to the Manes of deceased ancestors).

न्युङ्ख न्युङ्ख, अस्, m. a kind of Sāman, the
sixfold repetition of the triliteral name of God or
ॐ, [cf. न्यूङ्ख]; (अस्, आ, अम्), proper, right;
pleasing, agreeable.

न्यूङ्ख न्यूङ्ख, अस्, m. the insertion of the
sound ओ in different places with variety of prosodial
length and accentuation in the recitation of hymns,
(this sound may be repeated any number of times in
the recitation of Mantras, or may be made long,
short, or prolated, or may have different accents.)

न्युच् न्य्-उच्, cl. 4. P. -उच्यति, &c., Ved. to
rejoice in, delight in, take pleasure in; (Sāy.) to
assent to, agree to.

न्युत्त न्य्-उत्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. उद् or उन्द्
with नि), dipped in, sprinkled.

न्य्-उप्य, ind. having offered, having presented
(cakes &c. to the Manes).

न्युब्ज् न्य्-उब्ज्, cl. 6. P. -उब्जति, &c., to
bend down, press down, throw down.

न्य्-उब्ज, अस्, आ, अम्, turned or bent downwards,
lying on the face or with the face downwards;
looking downwards; bent, crooked; hump-backed,
crooked-backed (as the result of disease); convex;
(अस्), m. the Nyag-rodha tree; a sort of ladle made
of Kuśa grass; (अम्), n. the fruit of the Averrhoa
Carambola; a vessel used at Śrāddhas.
—न्युब्ज-
खड्ग, अस्, m. a crooked sword, a sabre.

न्युष् न्य्-उष् [cf. rt. 1. उष्], cl. 1. P. -ओषति,
&c., Ved. to burn down; (Sāy.) to consume utterly.

न्यूङ्खय, Nom. P. न्यूङ्खयति, -यितुम्, to
insert the Nyūṅkha, (occurring in fut. pass. part.
न्यूङ्खनीय and न्यूङ्ख्य); (A. -ते), to make
a peculiar sound, to growl.

न्यून न्य्-ऊन, अस्, आ, अम् (see ऊन), lessened,
diminished, shortened, made smaller, less, inferior,
deficient, defective, wanting, destitute, deprived of
(e. g. अर्थ-न्यून, deprived of property, destitute
of wealth); imperfect or defective in some organ (e. g.
पाद-न्यून, having a defect in the feet); low, vile,
wicked, despicable, blamable; (अम्), ind. less; (अम्),
n. an euphemistic expression for the vulva.
—न्यून-
ता, f. or न्यून-त्व, अम्, n. inferiority, deficiency,
incompleteness.
—न्यून-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, deficient
in intellect, ignorant, foolish.
—न्यून-पञ्चाशद्-
भाव, अस्, n. ‘having but forty-nine properties of
human nature,’ an idiot.
—न्यूनाक्षर (˚न-अक्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, defective in letters or syllables.
—न्यू-
नाङ्ग (˚न-अङ्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, defective in a limb or
organ, maimed, mutilated, imperfect.
—न्यूनाधिक
(˚न-अध्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, less or more, unequal.
—न्यू-
नाधिक-विभाग, अस्, m. unequal partition.
—न्यू-
नेन्द्रिय (˚न-इन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, wanting some organ
or sense, deficient, imperfect (as blind, deaf, &c.).

न्यूनय, Nom. P. न्यूनयति, -यितुम्, or
न्यूनी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्,
to lessen, diminish, make less.

न्यूह् न्य्-ऊह् [cf. rt. 2. ऊह्], cl. 1. A. -ओहते
or -ऊहते, Ved. to attend to, observe; (Sāy.) to bear
up or support completely, (as if fr. rt. 1. ऊह्.)
